{{Quote|Good. Now order our cannons to target their rear units. We'll box them in and blast them to pieces.|The OOM command battle droid|<ref name="LoR" />}}
This '''[[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droid]]''' served as a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]]. He led the [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] stationed on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcers]], which were commanded by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]. When the [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] were advancing through a road above a canyon, the droid tried to trap them on the road by ordering his [[Tank/Legends|tanks]] to shoot and cripple both the front and the rear AT-TEs. Although the droid's AATs managed to cripple the first walker, [[General/Legends|General]] Windu cleared the road by [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force pushing]] the crippled AT-TE out of the way. The Jedi then led the [[Lightning Squadron/Legends|Lightning Squadron]] against the AATs, destroying the tanks and the commander droid in process.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Now that Jedi is leading the attack! This doesn't look good. Concentrate all your fire on those walkers!|The OOM command battle droid|<ref name="LoR" />}}
This [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droid]] served in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="LoR" /> in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="SW Annual 2011" /> When the Confederacy's member organization [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|invaded]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] with its [[Techno Union Droid Army/Legends|droid army]], this [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was deployed as a [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of a group of [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] on the planet.<ref name="LoR" />

[[File:RylothOOMcommander-LoR.png|thumb|left|200px|The OOM command battle droid and a B1 battle droid]]
During the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] attempt to liberate the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]], the command droid commanded [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Tank/Legends|tanks]] against a column of [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. When the Republic [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] were moving forward in a winding road above a canyon, the AATs attacked them from the other side of it. The command droid was in a [[Separatist command center/Legends|Separatist command center]] with his [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] [[Adjutant/Legends|adjutant]], where they oversaw the battle. After his AATs managed to cripple the first AT-TE, which blocked the way from the rest of the walkers, the droid ordered his tanks to also cripple the rear units of the AT-TEs, hoping to trap the column on the road. However, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], the leading [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] of the Republic forces, was able to [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Telekinesis/Legends|push]] the crippled AT-TE out of the road, and led the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Lightning Squadron/Legends|Lightning Squadron]] against the AATs with the [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transports]]. Noticing the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] counter-attack, the command droid ordered his tanks to destroy the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], but the walkers proved to be too fast to be shot. The droid considered surrender and asked the B1 if it would be better, but the Jedi [[General/Legends|General]] had already reached the Separatist [[command center]], and Windu destroyed both droids with the [[Laser/Legends|laser]] weaponry of his AT-RT. The droid's tanks were defeated shortly after as well, and the Republic forces would eventually liberate Ryloth from the Separatist occupation.<ref name="LoR" />

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Should we run?''"<br />"''It would be better if we just surrender— aahh!|The B1's and the OOM's last words|<ref name="LoR" />}}
[[File:RylothOOMcommanderdoom-LoR.png|thumb|right|220px|The OOM commander a moment before he is destroyed]]
A battle droid with a [[Gender/Legends|masculine personality]], this [[OOM-series battle droid/Legends|OOM-series]] commander droid was in charge of a group of AATs. When his aide, who was equipped with an [[Electrobinoculars/Legends|electrobinoculars]], reported about the actions of the Republic forces, the command droid wanted to see the events himself before giving any orders, and borrowed the electrobinoculars twice during the battle. His tactic was to trap the Republic walkers into the road above the deep canyon by disabling both the first and the last AT-TE, preventing the rest of the walkers for advancing and leaving them to be destroyed by his tanks. However, he did not count the [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] of Jedi Master Windu, who managed to clear the road. When Windu led the Lightning Squadron against the droid's AATs, the droid immediately identified him as a Jedi, and ordered his tanks to eliminate the attackers. When the walkers evaded the tanks fire and approached the two droids, his adjutant asked should they escape, but the command droid thought that a surrender would be a better option, though he failed to achieve it when he was gunned down with his aide.<ref name="LoR" />

==Behind the scenes==
This droid first and only appeared in the [[Liberty on Ryloth]], the second to last episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. Like all B1 and OOM-series battle droids in the series, he was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]], who also provided the voice of [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] in the same episode.<ref name="LoR" />
